headline: Full 4-Unit Apartment Building Renovation
articleBody:
Marcelle Melka's team renovated a 4-unit LA building, coordinating with tenants, handling changes, and completing ahead of holiday deadline despite tight schedules. diditangroup​

Outcome: Project finished impeccably and on time like "newly built construction"; units are now comfortable and high-quality, with strong client-team rapport. diditangroup​
